description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'GroupMemberNotFoundInGSIMException' used in the Fineract project. It extends 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException' and is thrown when a group member with a specific client ID is not found in GSIM.

classes.name: GroupMemberNotFoundInGSIMException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a group member was not found in GSIM, referencing a specific client ID.

methods.name: GroupMemberNotFoundInGSIMException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message key, detailed message including the client ID, and the client ID itself.

calls: super("error.msg.Group.member.not.found.in.linked.gsim", "The client with id `" + clientId + "` is not present in GSIM", clientId)
